## Narrative

US-based non-profit IT certification body. Vendor-neutral certs span IT generalist (A+ / Network+) → security (Security+ / PenTest+ / CySA+ / CASP+). Many CompTIA certs are DoD 8570 approved, driving heavy adoption in US federal + defense hiring. [CONFIRMED]
